_note: Sizing caps mirrored from Revenue Plan.md's Path 1 order card, kept here as structured policy so order_executor.py enforces them in code instead of trusting a human to read prose before submitting an order. Update this file when Revenue Plan.md's caps change -- they already have, twice (Hormuz 6%->4%, recession 2%->1%, both cut 2026-08-04). An unlisted claim_class is refused, not defaulted to the absolute ceiling -- a new market must be added here deliberately before it can be sized.
_absolute_ceiling_note: Revenue Plan.md: 'Never size any single framework claim above 10% regardless of stated edge.' Applies even if a claim_class entry below is misconfigured above 10.
_aggregate_drawdown_halt_note: 2026-08-13, user-set. Checked per venue (Alpaca book and OANDA book independently -- NOT combined cross-venue) before any new order: if that venue's current aggregate unrealized P&L across open positions is already a loss of >=10% of bankroll, EVERY new order on that venue is refused regardless of its own claim_class headroom. This is separate from and in addition to the per-order max_pct_of_bankroll caps below -- entry-sizing limits how much goes IN, this limits how much MORE goes in once the book is already bleeding. Per-position stop-loss (closing an individual losing position automatically, target range discussed: 15-20% DD per position) is scoped but NOT implemented -- this halt only blocks NEW orders, it does not close anything that's already open.
